schemes.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
schemes.description: Financial support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families. Provides Rs. 6000 per year in three equal instalments, subject to exclusions.

conditions: Must be a landholding farmer family with cultivable land recorded in state or UT land records
Certain constitutional post holders, government employees, pensioners, income-tax payers and practising professionals are excluded under scheme rules

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Urban 2.0
schemes.description: Government housing assistance scheme for eligible urban families.

conditions: Family must live in an urban area
Family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India
EWS annual household income up to Rs. 3 lakh
LIG annual household income above Rs. 3 lakh and up to Rs. 6 lakh
MIG annual household income above Rs. 6 lakh and up to Rs. 9 lakh
Previous housing scheme benefits within the last 20 years may make the family ineligible
